import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    df = df.drop_duplicates(subset=['penguin_id'], keep='first')
    df['body_mass_g'] = df['body_mass_g'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)
    df.loc[(df['body_mass_g'] < 2500) | (df['body_mass_g'] > 6500), 'body_mass_g'] = pd.NA
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = pd.to_numeric(df['flipper_length_mm'], errors='coerce')
    df.loc[(df['flipper_length_mm'] < 170) | (df['flipper_length_mm'] > 235), 'flipper_length_mm'] = pd.NA
    df['island'] = df['island'].str.strip()
    return df

def answer(df):
    grouped = df.groupby('sex')['body_mass_g'].mean().to_dict()
    return {k: v for k, v in grouped.items() if pd.notna(k) and pd.notna(v)}
